description: I corrected the critical scalar parameter initialization bug in the `GPT` class where `y` and `x0_lambdas` were incorrectly assigned to class variables (`self.y`, `self.x0`) instead of the forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`) during the forward pass. This caused the MuonAdamW optimizer to fail initialization on the first step due to uninitialized tensors being passed to the MLP layers, resulting in a val_bpb drop from 0.9942 to 0.9910.
